description: Read one competitor's detected page feed with covered/partial/gap matching and excerpts; filter by match or triage. Pages whose content has not been fetched yet appear with matchReason=not-enriched and are counted in counts.pending. Matching compares page content signatures against the parent site's latest completed audit pages, never against Google or traffic data. Requires the sites:read scope.
name: get_competitor_feed
title: One competitor's detected page feed
